li.label: itchy bumps
li.description: Little red bumps all over my legs from that swim. I keep catching myself scratching.

li.label: itching all over
li.description: Everywhere the water touched me itches. I could tear my skin off.

li.label: cold, numb feet
li.description: My feet feel like blocks of wood that someone else is walking on.

li.label: swollen feet
li.description: My feet are swollen and they burn now that they're warm. Every step is a chore.

li.label: aching eyes
li.description: My eyes ache when I move them and the light hurts. The fever's coming, I can feel it.

li.label: a high fever
li.description: Burning up and shivering at once. Three days of this, they say, and nothing to be done.

li.label: a festering wound
li.description: The wound smells wrong and won't close. The heat gets into everything here.

li.label: an open ulcer
li.description: The sore has eaten into the skin around the wound. I can't stand to look at it.

li.label: a fever and a sore
li.description: A fever, and the nick on my finger from the butchering has gone angry and red.

li.label: swollen glands
li.description: The lumps under my arm are tender as bruises and the fever won't break.

li.label: a taste of metal
li.description: Everything tastes of the forge, and my muscles ache like I've been beaten.

li.label: chills and fever
li.description: Shivering in the heat and sweating in the cold. It's the fumes, they say. It'll pass.

li.label: a chafed stump
li.description: The stump's sore where the limb sits on it. I'll be glad to take it off tonight.

li.label: a raw stump
li.description: My stump is rubbed raw. Every step reminds me of what I lost.

li.label: a fever from the new part
li.description: A fever since the new part went in. I can almost feel the little machines finding their way.

li.label: aching joints
li.description: Every joint aches while the mechanites settle. I hope they settle soon.

li.label: a black sore
li.description: A sore with a black heart on my hand, where I nicked it at the butcher's block.

li.label: swelling and fever
li.description: My whole arm has swollen up and the fever's on me. I keep thinking about that carcass.

li.label: sickness in the blood
li.description: It's in my blood now. I can feel it in every part of me.

li.label: poisoned blood
li.description: I can't think straight and I can hardly breathe. I'm frightened.

li.label: a cough and fever
li.description: A dry cough and a fever, weeks after all that digging. The dust got into me.

li.label: aching joints
li.description: My joints ache and there's a red rash on my shins. It's slow, and it won't let go.

li.label: a spreading fever
li.description: It's getting worse, not better. Every day I'm weaker than the day before.

li.label: fever through my body
li.description: It's everywhere now. I can't get out of bed.

li.label: fever and headache
li.description: A fever and a headache that splits my skull. All from sweeping out the coop.

li.label: a dry cough
li.description: A dry cough that won't stop, and every one of them hurts my head.

li.label: pneumonia
li.description: It's gone to my lungs. I can't get a full breath.

li.label: failing lungs
li.description: Every breath is a fight. I'm so tired of fighting.
